name: nf_tools_columns
description: Per-column analyzer assignments for the nf-tools SearchIndex (syn75081636, source syn51730943). Roles: IDENTIFIER for id-like fields (preserve punctuation, no stemming); nf_scientific_synonyms for free-text scientific/discovery fields (stemming + NF synonym expansion at search time); KEYWORD for demographic/internal-flag facet fields with no free-text search role (exact match). resourceType and cellLineCategory are deliberately NOT KEYWORD despite being facet-like: they're also searched as natural-language terms (e.g. 'hybridoma cell line', 'melanoma cell line' in benchmark/tools/fields.yaml), and KEYWORD's exact-match-only behavior broke those queries entirely (confirmed 2026-07-07 benchmark regression) — they fall through to the config defaultAnalyzer (STANDARD) instead, like resourceName, species, and other free-text/multi-value/date columns. Columns absent from the index are silently skipped at build time.
